title: Account start
summary: Opens the account that lives on this phone. Device-first accounts have no login screen (ADR 0057): the app signs in with the hidden password from the device credential store, then restores the session on later starts.

phase.description: opening: restoring a session or signing in. noAccount: no session and no device credential. failed: the sign-in or restore failed. ready: the session runs and the app shows chat-list.

userId.description: The Matrix ID of the account, when one is known.

start.effect: On launch: restore the saved SDK session if one exists; else read the newest device credential (BipeKit BipeCredentialStore.password() on iOS, libraries/bipe on Android) and sign in with it; else go to noAccount.

notes: Sign-in uses MAS compatibility login (m.login.password on /_matrix/client/v3/login). bipe-infra compose/templates/mas-bipe.yaml keeps passwords.enabled true for this.
The homeserver comes from the build configuration, never from the user.
The SDK session store and the saved session live in the app group (iOS) or app storage (Android), so the switch from the fork can reuse them (client-rewrite-study.md section 6).
Sign-up, recovery, the PIN and the app lock are later screens. In the slice, noAccount only explains that an account must already be on the phone.
Never log or show the password or the recovery token.
